locator: I q.2 a.3 co., tertia via: Si igitur omnia sunt possibilia non esse, aliquando nihil fuit in rebus
interpretation: Reading B of how the step is licensed: 'omnia' is collective and the preceding sentence states plenitude, so the step applies plenitude over an infinite past to the possibility that nothing is. On this reading the step is valid but rests on two further premises: collective possibility and an infinite past.
